import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict
from lottolab.research import b649_loo_oos_validation as v
root=Path.cwd()
path=root/"docs/research/b649-loo-stability-tiebreak-oos-outcome-validation-r1-result.json"
result=json.loads(path.read_bytes())
draws=v.load_draws(Path(result["source_database"]))
assert v.digest([asdict(d) for d in draws]) == result["source_logical_sha256"]
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(v.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == result["evaluation_module_sha256"]
assert v.verify_authority(root) == result["frozen_source_sha256"]
by_draw={d.draw_number:(i,d) for i,d in enumerate(draws)}
target_sets=[]
for k in v.SUPPORTED_K:
    group=result["by_k"][str(k)]
    rows=group["paired_draws"]
    targets=[r["target_draw"] for r in rows]
    assert len(targets)==len(set(targets))==group["valid_paired_draws"]
    target_sets.append(set(targets))
    for row in rows:
        i,target=by_draw[row["target_draw"]]
        assert (row["target_date"],row["k"],row["history_count"]) == (target.draw_date,k,i)
        assert (row["cutoff_draw"],row["cutoff_date"]) == (draws[i-1].draw_number,draws[i-1].draw_date)
        assert draws[i-1].key < target.key
        selections=[]
        for side in ("baseline","candidate"):
            tickets=tuple(tuple(t) for t in row[side+"_tickets"])
            assert len(tickets)==len(set(tickets))==k
            assert v.score(tickets,target,k)==row[side]
            selections.append(tickets)
        assert v.digest(selections)==row["selection_sha256"]
    summary=v.summarize(rows)
    expected={key:value for key,value in group["full_history"].items() if key!="primary_holm_adjusted_p_value"}
    assert v.encoded(summary)==v.encoded(expected)
    for window in v.RECENT_WINDOWS:
        selected={d.draw_number for d in draws[-window:]}
        assert v.encoded(v.summarize([r for r in rows if r["target_draw"] in selected])) == v.encoded(group["recent_stability"][str(window)])
assert target_sets[0]==target_sets[1]==target_sets[2]
excluded={r["target_draw"] for r in result["excluded_targets"]}
assert not (excluded & target_sets[0]) and excluded | target_sets[0] == set(by_draw)
for i in range(len(result["by_k"]["5"]["paired_draws"])):
    rows=[result["by_k"][str(k)]["paired_draws"][i] for k in v.SUPPORTED_K]
    assert len({r["history_sha256"] for r in rows})==len({r["pool_sha256"] for r in rows})==1
    for side in ("baseline","candidate"):
        assert rows[0][side+"_tickets"]==rows[1][side+"_tickets"][:5]
        assert rows[1][side+"_tickets"]==rows[2][side+"_tickets"][:10]
assert v.verdict([result["by_k"][str(k)]["full_history"] for k in v.SUPPORTED_K],identical_tickets=False)==result["candidate_verdict"]
print("PASS: exact source identity, unchanged canonical logical dataset, all 5337 draw-K pairs rescored, complete exclusions, same-draw/cutoff/pool/K, nested budgets, all full/recent summaries deterministically reproduced.")
print("RESULT_SHA256",hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
